name: herdr-fleet-quota
description: Per-machine AI quota readings for Herdr, using existing local collector records.

scripts.check: for f in mods/fleet-quota/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && sh -n scripts/install.sh && bash -n scripts/install-refresh.sh && python3 -B -c 'import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(p).read(), p) for p in sys.argv[1:]]' scripts/refresh.py
